recognize_zh: 高倍下大腸腺窩之間的固有層充滿帶亮橘紅色粗顆粒、雙葉核的嗜酸性球，部分嗜酸性球已進入腺窩上皮；此圖本身主要呈現嗜酸性球浸潤，肥大細胞在 H&E 上不易辨認，需搭配 CD117/CD25 才能支持肥大細胞增生症。
features: Lamina propria between crypts densely infiltrated by eosinophils with bright orange-red coarse granules and bilobed nuclei
Focal intraepithelial eosinophils within crypt epithelium
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cells and a few pale oval mononuclear cells
Crypts retain goblet cells without architectural distortion or crypt abscesses
Neoplastic mast cells are not reliably distinguishable on H&E at this magnification
describe_en: High-power view of colonic mucosa (H&E) shows a lamina propria densely infiltrated by eosinophils, with focal extension of eosinophils into the crypt epithelium. Admixed lymphocytes, plasma cells and occasional pale oval mononuclear cells are present, while crypts remain intact without distortion or crypt abscesses. The eosinophil-rich infiltrate is nonspecific on its own; spindled mast cells are not clearly discernible in this field. Findings are compatible with the eosinophil-rich component of mucosal mastocytosis when correlated with CD117, tryptase and CD25 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Morphology of the eosinophilic infiltrate may be identical, and only demonstration of CD117/tryptase/CD25-positive mast cell aggregates establishes mastocytosis.
Parasite-associated eosinophilia may show larvae or ova and lacks aberrant CD25-positive mast cells.
Medication reactions give eosinophil-rich lamina propria often with apoptosis, and are excluded by drug history rather than morphology.
PDGFRA-rearranged neoplasms can mimic mastocytosis with eosinophils and CD25-positive mast cells, and are distinguished by FIP1L1::PDGFRA testing rather than KIT D816V.
